highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Founded in 1961, ISTEC Business School is a private higher education institution located in the heart of Paris. It is officially recognised by the French State and is a member of the elite Conférence des Grandes Écoles. The school specialises in marketing, business development, and management, offering a human-scale learning environment where you are treated as an individual rather than just a number.

ISTEC is particularly known for its "Grande École" programme and its strong focus on international orientation, with over 58 international destinations available for exchange semesters.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
At ISTEC, you will experience a dynamic and fulfilling associative life. The school hosts numerous student associations that allow you to engage in cultural, athletic, and professional projects outside of your studies.

The campus culture is inclusive and multicultural, designed to prepare you for a global career. To help you settle in, the university provides dedicated international student support services, including welcome seminars and an international help desk.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
While ISTEC does not have its own traditional dormitories, it offers extensive housing support for international students. You can access priority housing through partner residences located near the campus in Paris.

Commonly used student residences include Les Estudines and Studelites, which offer furnished apartments with private bathrooms and shared kitchens. If you are looking for budget-friendly options, the university also provides links to various student housing platforms specifically for its students.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
1. Library

You will have access to a digital work environment and methodological support to assist with your research. The school provides resources to help you master academic tools and access relevant business literature.

2. Sports

ISTEC offers a variety of cultural and athletic activities. Through student associations, you can join sports clubs and participate in competitions and fitness events organised throughout the academic year.

3. Laboratories

As a business-focused school, ISTEC provides specialised learning spaces, including an incubator (Istec x EEMI Incubator) designed for students looking to launch their own start-ups and business projects.

4. Cafeteria

The campus is situated in a lively district of Paris, surrounded by numerous cafes, restaurants, and dining options. On-campus areas are also available for you to relax and enjoy food and beverages between classes.

highlights.title: Campuses
highlights.value:
Paris (Jemmapes)

The main campus is located at 128 Quai de Jemmapes in the 10th arrondissement, right on the edge of the beautiful Canal Saint-Martin.

Location: In the heart of a vibrant, trendy district of Paris.

Transport: The campus is easily accessible, located just 10 to 20 minutes from major metro lines and about an hour from Paris’s main airports.

Student Experience: You will be surrounded by galleries, cultural attractions, and a bustling city atmosphere that blends academic life with the unique Parisian lifestyle.
